files.pkgs/demo/package.toml:
name = "demo"
version = "0.2.0"
summary = "demo package"
caps = ["read", "write", "exec"]
detect = ["demo.marker"]

[check]
recognize = ["sh *"]

[check.patterns]
passed = '(\d+) ok'
failure = '(?m)^FAIL (\w+)(?:: (.*))?$'

[check.test]
cmd = ["sh", "-c", "echo '3 ok'; echo 'FAIL two: nope'; exit 1"]

[[command]]
name = "greet"
summary = "greet someone"
params = [{ name = "who", type = "str", positional = true, required = true }, { name = "loud", type = "bool" }]
input = "who"
caps = ["read"]
examples = ["demo.greet \"jo\" loud:true"]
run = '''
let msg = "hi $who"
if $loud { upper($msg) } else { $msg }
'''

[[command]]
name = "save"
summary = "write a file, then fail"
caps = ["write"]
run = '''
write "made.txt" "x"
rm "missing"
'''

[[command]]
name = "loop"
summary = "calls itself"
caps = ["read"]
run = "demo.loop"
files.pkgs/narrow/package.toml:
name = "narrow"
version = "1.0.0"
summary = "read-only package"
caps = ["read"]

[[command]]
name = "shell"
summary = "tries to run a program"
run = 'exec "echo" "hi"'
